# MNIST-on-grass data manifest

Generated by `scripts/mnist_grass_manifest.py` on the cluster. The files themselves are not committed (size and ImageNet terms; `data/raw/` and `data/processed/` are gitignored).

## Sources

- Grass: `ImageNet-20261030T152523Z-1-001.zip`, the cPCA authors' Google Drive folder of ImageNet synset n12102133 images, unzipped into `data/raw/grass/`.
- MNIST: `https://storage.googleapis.com/tensorflow/tf-keras-datasets/mnist.npz`, into `data/raw/`; its SHA-256 matches the hash Keras pins.
